title: runLoopEvaluatorProcess
responsibility: Runs one bounded evaluator or project-check subprocess under a Harness resource lease, tracking its process and forwarding only the requested environment.

inputs.name: runLoopEvaluatorProcess.root
inputs.description: Working directory of the command or isolated semantic evaluation.

inputs.name: runLoopEvaluatorProcess.argv
inputs.description: Executable followed by arguments. No shell is inserted.

inputs.name: runLoopEvaluatorProcess.options
inputs.description: Explicit stdin, environment, elapsed time, and output bounds for the subprocess.

inputs.name: runLoopEvaluatorProcess.label
inputs.description: Name used for the Harness resource lease. Defaults to Semantic evaluator.

outputs.name: runLoopEvaluatorProcess
outputs.description: Resolves with exit code and captured streams from the bounded command under a Harness resource lease.
